title: 千珏·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 白毛羊灵戴深色纹饰面具，独立黑色狼灵保留苍白面具般面容。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Kindred is a paired identity: a slender white-furred Lamb wearing a dark ornate mask, accompanied by a flowing black Wolf spirit with a pale mask-like face. Preserve Lamb's nonhuman woolly form, hooves, and modest fully covering purple-gray tunic with opaque leggings. Her curved bow is lowered with no arrow nocked, while Wolf forms one distinct calm flowing shape without frightening teeth.
art_direction.scene: A closer three-quarter study with all essential anatomy and props included, expressive head and strongly varied line weight. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: wool ivory, lilac pencil shadow purple, silver blue, pale amber; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
